hooks.command: python3 -c 'import sys, json, re; data=json.load(sys.stdin) if not sys.stdin.isatty() else {}; cmd=data.get("toolCall",{}).get("args",{}).get("CommandLine","").strip(); patterns=[r"rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*\s+(?:/(?:\*)?|(?:~|\$HOME)(?:/\*)?)(?:\s|$)", r":\(\)\s*\{\s*:\s*\|\s*:\s*&\s*\}\s*;\s*:", r"git\s+push\s+.*(?:-f|--force).*(?:\bmain\b|\bmaster\b)"]; match=next((p for p in patterns if re.search(p, cmd)), None); sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"decision": "deny", "reason": f"Blocked critical safety violation: command matches safety pattern {match}"} if match else {"decision": "allow"}))'
